description: Aviation Mechanic General: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
sourceShort: FAA handbooks, the ACS and 14 CFR
notice: Contains material from 14 CFR parts 1, 39, 43, 45, 65 and 91, the FAA Aviation Mechanic General, Airframe, and Powerplant Airman Certification Standards and its Companion Guide, the Aviation Maintenance Technician Handbook – General (FAA-H-8083-30B) and Advisory Circular 43.13-1B, which are US Government works in the public domain; some handbook images are third-party material and are not reproduced. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by the Federal Aviation Administration, the U.S. Department of Transportation or PSI Services LLC. The Aviation Mechanic General knowledge test (AMG) is an FAA test delivered at PSI testing centres.

glossary.JET: the jet fuel grade prefix (as in JET A and JET B)
glossary.RAD: the radiation symbol on hazardous material labels
glossary.MS: Military Standard (as in MS part numbers)
glossary.NPN: a bipolar transistor with a P-type base between two N-type regions
glossary.PNP: a bipolar transistor with an N-type base between two P-type regions
glossary.AND: the logic gate whose output is true only when all inputs are true
glossary.OR: the logic gate whose output is true when any input is true
glossary.NOR: NOT OR: the logic gate whose output is true only when all inputs are false
glossary.NAND: NOT AND: the logic gate whose output is false only when all inputs are true

checks.what: Six independent audits read all 2145 cards against the FAA sources they quote (the Aviation Mechanic General ACS, the AMT Handbook FAA-H-8083-30B, AC 43.13-1B and 14 CFR), found word for word by the card checker; every calculation was worked again and every figure compared with its source
checks.result: Fourteen wrong cards fixed, most of them worked answers whose stated reasons did not produce the numbers, plus a fire-extinguisher class, a cut-out's location, where wing stations are measured from and an anti-misfuelling rule that needs all three conditions; 8 ambiguous cards, 3 unsupported claims and 18 unclear ones fixed; 14 application cards added for core concepts that had none.
